card: Adds unit test coverage for malformed partial merkle tree handling and edge cases in difficulty target calculation. Tests verify rejection of trees exceeding the 16,666 transaction boundary or having invalid bit and hash counts, and confirm GetBitsProof returns zero for negative, zero, and overflowing targets. The author identified these coverage gaps while working on the bitcoin-s alternative implementation.
evidence: PR description: "These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)"
problem: Bitcoin Core lacks unit test coverage for several invalid CPartialMerkleTree structures—notably at the maximum transaction boundary—and for edge-case nBits targets in GetBitsProof, risking unverified divergence between implementations or regressions.

risk.why: Only adds unit test cases for existing consensus-adjacent helper functions and does not touch production code.

summary: Adds unit tests covering edge cases in partial merkle tree extraction and proof-of-work target calculations. It tests malformed partial merkle trees, including empty trees, bit- and hash-count mismatches, and the 16,666 transaction limit boundary. It also verifies that GetBitsProof returns zero for zero, negative, and overflowing nBits target representations.
